title: Save in the warning saves the staff member and unassigns nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, who holds nothing except the work named below.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in In Progress, led by staff member A, with no line that staff member A is on, so the warning has a led work order to count.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 2, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B, with one line, line 1, holding a labor entry for staff member A, so staff member A is on one line.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Technician off.
  3. Click Save & Close.
  4. Click Save in the warning.
  5. Open work order 1.
  6. Open work order 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Staff Member window opens with Technician on.

Step 2:

  • The Technician toggle is off.

Step 3:

  • The warning window titled "Turn Off Technician" shows, with a Cancel button and a Save button.
  • Its text reads "[staff member A's first and last name] leads 1 open work order and is on 1 labor line. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."

Step 4:

  • The warning and the window close.
  • Staff member A's row shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 5:

  • Staff member A is still the lead of work order 1.

Step 6:

  • Line 1 still shows staff member A's labor entry, unchanged.

In the warning texts, [staff member A's first and last name] stands for staff member A's name exactly as it was last saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off)

  • S2-R4: “The window has Cancel and Save. Save continues the staff save as in S1-R6. Cancel, the X or Escape close the warning and leave the staff member unsaved, with the staff window still open and the toggle as the user left it; clicking outside the warning does nothing. While the counts load after Save, the Save button shows its loading state and cannot be clicked again. Closing the staff window while the counts load cancels the save: nothing is saved and no warning shows. Save in the warning saves the staff member exactly as the window showed when the warning opened.”
  • S2-R5: “Saving with Technician off unassigns nothing. Every lead and labor line stays as it was (Story 3, S3-R7 and S3-R8).”
  • S1-R6: “Switching Technician on or off changes nothing until the user saves the staff member with the window's existing Save. Once saved, the change applies to every technician list (Story 3) the next time each list loads (S1-E3).”
  • Key Decisions: “Turning Technician off warns and then allows; it never unassigns.”
  • S2-R3, 1 work order, 1 line: “1 work order, 1 line: "[Name] leads 1 open work order and is on 1 labor line. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "4 Turn Technician off with open work", pictures "Turn Off Technician warning" (This build) and "Switched off" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p4-02-after-turn-off-technician-warning.png
  • tt-p4-01-after-switched-off.png

The design's own words:

  • “Save shows this first, only when the person still leads an open work order or is on a line of one (with labor, added with Add Technician, or as the line's technician), at any location. Otherwise Save goes straight on.”
  • “Text, verbatim with this demo's counts: "Emily Madden leads 15 open work orders and is on 141 labor lines. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."”
  • “Cancel, the X or Escape leave the staff member unsaved. Save continues the save. Nothing is unassigned either way.”
  • “Technician switched off, not saved yet. Switching Time Clock off has the same effect, because it turns Technician off.”

The design draws the plural form only ("Emily Madden leads 15 open work orders and is on 141 labor lines"); the single-count forms are not drawn (register TT-N04). The text comes from S2-R3.
